observer: Claude (Opus 5.5), 9 Nov 2026: the raw scan (1841 x 2083) blurred 3x3, in nine tiles at full size with a 0.02 grid and closer crops (contrast-lifted in the dark corners), against a reference render of the cabin from about the right place (not the photo's camera: the photo has no view yet) and the hull builder (tools/blender/build_cabin_interior.py build_door)
covers: the door to the engine compartment whole (its seal, the pressed frame round it, ribs, plates, handle, latches, hinge pockets), the bulkhead round it, the blue lamp at the top left, the angled hood and the tube at the top right with the equipment above it, the blower's framed opening at the right, the low hinged cover under the door and the padded item at the left edge
notes: Image left is the vehicle's right (the camera looks aft); the red plate's text reads the right way, so the print is not mirrored. The door is hinged on the vehicle's right (the image's left) and latched on its left: the model's door (build_door) is handed the other way, its hinge barrels on the centreline side and its handle outboard. Inside its seal the door is about 1.35 times as high as wide (the observation's 1.4); the model's is 0.56 by 1.06 m, about 1.9 times, and reaches nearly to the floor, where the photo's sits above a bead and a sill. The ribs, the handle's pocket and the two hinge pockets are pressed IN (away from the cabin): the camera is at about the door's mid-height, and the upper features show their upper walls, the lower ones their lower walls, and the ribs' ends the walls that face the camera. No hinge knuckle shows in the cabin. Sizes are given against the door's width (0.56 m on the plan p029) or against other things in the photo.

details.what: the door's outline inside its seal: a tall rounded rectangle about 1.35 times as high as wide, corners of a radius about a twelfth of its width, its bottom edge well above a sill bead (the model's door is about 1.9 times as high as wide, with corners about a seventh of its width, and reaches nearly to the floor)
details.size_cue: inside the seal about 0.57 of the frame wide and 0.67 high; the corner radius about the rib's height
details.note: the model has a rounded flat panel of the wrong proportions; its height wants re-estimating from this ratio and the plan's width

details.what: the black rubber seal in the gap all round the door, a finger wide, following the door's rounded corners, matt black and slightly glossy at the bottom
details.size_cue: about a third of a rib's height wide
details.note: the model's dark outline is the opening's reveal round its own, too tall door

details.what: the opening's inner lip: a narrow light flange just outside the seal, then a dark crease outside it, all round the opening (on the hinge side at x 0.125 and 0.117, on the latch side at x 0.715 and 0.73)
details.size_cue: the lip about as wide as the seal

details.what: the pressed frame round the door opening: a broad convex bead standing proud of the flat bulkhead, widest on the latch side (x 0.735-0.79, about an eighth of the door's width), narrower on the hinge side (x 0.05-0.10) and across the top and bottom, its corners rounded to follow the door's; its top-right corner runs in behind the angled hood
details.size_cue: about an eighth of the door's width wide on the latch side, a tenth elsewhere

details.what: a vertical joint across the frame's top bead above the red plate's right half: the bead's bright streaks stop at it

four long horizontal pressed channels across the door with rounded ends, pressed in (away from the cabin), each about 0.8 of the door's inner width long and a tenth of it high, at y 0.16, 0.35, 0.54 and 0.72, all ending at x 0.19-0.20 and 0.645-0.655
details.size_cue: about a tenth of the door's width high; the red plate's height is two of them
details.note: pressed in: the upper two show their upper walls, the lowest its lower wall, the ends the walls facing the camera (medium confidence on the direction, high on the shape)

details.what: round screw heads in the floor of each channel, five per channel at x 0.22, 0.325, 0.43, 0.53 and 0.63 (the third channel's fifth under the lower latch's lever)
details.size_cue: heads about a fifth of the channel's height

details.what: the handle's pocket: a rounded-rectangle recess pressed into the door between the second and third channels, nearer the latch edge, for the fingers behind the strap
details.size_cue: about a quarter of the door's width wide, twice a channel's height high

details.what: the grab handle: a flat steel strap running level across the pocket's middle from a mount on its left to a rounded end with a screw just short of the seal
details.size_cue: about 0.4 of the door's width long, about half a channel's height wide
details.note: the model has a vertical round U-handle at the other (outboard, vehicle-right) edge of the door

details.what: the strap's left mount: a rectangular plate on a slightly raised pad, with a round boss and a screw in it (a rivet or pivot)
details.size_cue: the boss about twice a channel screw's head

details.what: two light backing plates in the pocket, one above and one below the strap, square-cornered
the backing plates' four screws, two on each plate
details.size_cue: as the channels' screws

details.what: the upper cam latch: a round steel lever with a rounded end, angled down and in towards the door's centre from its hub at the latch edge
details.size_cue: lever about 0.2 of the door's width long, about a third of a channel's height thick

details.what: the upper latch's hub and base: a light square plate on the door with two screws and the cam block on it, whose tongue reaches over the seal to the frame; the keeper it bears on is behind the hood's corner
the lower cam latch: a flat lever angled up and in towards the door's centre (mirroring the upper one), its upper end rounded over the third channel's end
details.size_cue: as the upper lever

details.what: the lower latch's cam plate on a rectangular mounting pad, three pins or screws on it, its nose reaching over the seal
the lower latch's keeper: a block on the frame's lip just outside the seal, with a clamp-shaped end, that the cam closes on

the hinge edge (image left, the vehicle's right): two small square pockets with rounded corners pressed into the door against the seal, top and bottom, where the hinges are bolted through; no knuckle shows on the cabin side
details.size_cue: each about a tenth of the door's width square
details.note: the model has round hinge barrels proud of the door on the other (centreline, vehicle-left) edge; pressed in by the same reading as the channels (medium)

details.what: two screw heads in each hinge pocket, one above the other
details.size_cue: as the channels' screws

details.what: the red enamel warning plate across the door between the first and second channels: rounded corners, a thin white border line, four lines of white capitals (headed ВНИМАНИЕ!; a warning against entering the engine compartment while the chassis moves or the GOM runs)
details.size_cue: about half the door's width wide, two channels' heights high
details.note: the register also has plate.door_warning (from g096-a); probably the same plate

details.what: the red plate's four corner rivets
details.note: the observation says six rivets; four are seen

details.what: a small square black plate under the third channel, left of the lower latch: a white drawing of the latch lever in its positions, with short white captions (open; closed - sealing)
details.size_cue: about a sixth of the door's width square

details.what: the black plate's four corner screws (bright heads)
two small lone studs or plugs on the door's plain field at x 0.41, one level with the handle's top and one level with the black plate
the door's paint: a pale grey with a slight green, cleaner and lighter than the bulkhead, slightly glossy under the flash, a few dark specks
details.note: the model's door is a flat mid grey

details.what: the bulkhead's paint: a pale grey-green, duller than the door, uneven, with a greyer wash towards the bottom
details.note: the model's bulkhead is a flat light grey

details.what: grime below the door: dark oily smudges and dust on the frame's lower bead and the strip above the low cover, streaks running down, worst over the cover's hinge and at the frame's bottom right corner
the frame bead's crest rubbed bright: white streaks along the top (two lines), down the latch side and along the bottom, ragged-edged (worn paint, with the flash's shine)
short dark scratches and dashes on the bulkhead between the frame and the blower opening, low down
a dark brown spot (dirt or rust) at the frame bead's bottom-left corner

a lit horizontal lip across the whole width under the door, about a fifth of the door's width below the door's bottom seal: a fold where the bulkhead's lower part steps out, or its junction with a floor plate
details.size_cue: about a fifth of the door's width below the seal
details.note: where the floor is here is not certain; g100-c shows the same line under the door

details.what: the blue lamp: a blue glass dome in a dark bezel ring, facing straight out of the bulkhead, its centre just off the frame's top-left corner; it sits outboard of the door's hinge-side top corner, about a quarter of the door's width outboard of its edge, its centre about level with the top of the frame bead
details.size_cue: the dome about a fifth of the door's width across
details.note: the cabin data puts the lamp over the door's middle (x 0.31); here it is outboard of the hinge edge, on the vehicle's right of the door. g092-a's blue lamp (on the right wall's corner, d22 there) may be a second lamp

details.what: the lamp's light grey round base flange outside the dark bezel
details.size_cue: about half as wide again as the dome

details.what: a light wire guard over the dome: a white bar crosses the dome's visible part
a screw on the lamp's base flange at its lower right

the angled hood: a blue-grey sheet housing standing out from the bulkhead above the blower opening, from the frame's top-right corner to beyond the frame's right edge; its left side a narrow flange running down beside the door's seal and over the frame bead, its bottom a straight lit lip; its upper face leans out over a darker lower face
details.size_cue: about half the door's width wide in view, its bottom level with the second channel

details.what: a diagonal fold across the hood's upper part, from the top right of its cover down to its left flange
brass screw heads on the hood: four at the corners of the small cover at its top left, five down its left flange, three along its bottom lip
details.size_cue: as the channels' screws

details.what: a small blue-grey cover at the hood's top left with a glossy face (two white flash streaks), screwed at its corners
details.note: may belong to the equipment above the hood rather than to the hood

details.what: the hood's paint: a blue-grey enamel, bluer than the bulkhead, its lower face in shadow; a reddish-brown stain on its upper face
details.note: the stain at x 0.78-0.84, y 0.22-0.28 (low confidence)

details.what: a grey tube across the front of the hood: in level from the right edge at the top of the hood's lower face, bending at about x 0.9, then diagonally down and left to the door frame's top-right corner, where a brass screw holds it
details.size_cue: about a thumb thick (about the latch lever's thickness)

details.what: a white clip or fitting on the tube just right of its bend
a narrow tan (brass-coloured or wooden) vertical strip above the hood at the right, tapering downward, ending on the hood at about a fifth of the frame's height
details.note: fan.rear_left is the observation's guess for the equipment above the hood; the register puts that fan far further left than this frame reaches

details.what: above the hood at the right edge: a white round housing's edge (a white ring) with cream and brass fittings below it, in a dark recess

the blower's tall framed opening in the bulkhead, cut by the frame's right edge: a light sheet-steel frame standing proud (a top bar, a light post at its right), its left edge throwing a dark shadow on the bulkhead
details.size_cue: at least a sixth of the door's width wide in view, about two thirds of the door's height tall

details.what: the blower in the opening's lower half: a black ring (housing) round a white-cream impeller or hub
details.size_cue: about a quarter of the door's width across

details.what: two screws on the blower's black ring and a brass terminal at its foot
a light grey plate closing the opening's foot below the blower, with screws at its corners
a small bright white tag or strip on the opening's foot plate
brass screws round the opening's frame: on the bulkhead down its left edge, above its top bar and on its right flange
a small black clip on the opening's inner wall above the blower
white cables at the opening's foot: one bends up from the bottom left corner into the foot plate, another runs right along the bulkhead's lower lip

details.what: the low cover under the door: a blue-grey sheet box about half the door's width wide standing proud of the bulkhead (its right side face shows as a dark strip), an inner panel line a little inside its left and right edges; cut by the frame's bottom
details.size_cue: about half the door's width wide

details.what: a piano hinge along the cover's top edge, its knuckles in short blue-grey lengths with the brass pin showing over the middle third
details.size_cue: the knuckles about as thick as the latch lever

details.what: a small white tab (a tag or a catch) at the hinge's left end
the cover's paint: blue-grey like the hood, clean below its hinge
a grey padded or cloth item at the image's left edge, from the handle's height down past the door's foot, its edge bound in black
details.note: stands in front of the bulkhead on the vehicle's right of the door; perhaps a folded seat back or a bag

details.what: a tan leather strap round the item's top, level with the third channel
a white fitting with a brass part above the strap (a buckle or a clip)
the item's black binding (or a black strap) hanging in zigzag folds down its edge to the bottom of the frame
